_comment: Current SimFly Telemetry Bridge release. Read by bridge.html (to resolve the download button) and by Active Airports (to tell a connected bridge that a newer one exists). Set available:false to take the download offline without editing the page; the page then renders `notice` instead of a download button, and Active Airports skips its update prompt because no version is offered.
name: SimFly Telemetry Bridge
notice: The download is temporarily unavailable while a third-party component licensing question is resolved. Existing installations are unaffected and will keep working.
